desc: Check pytest configuration, markers, and integration test separation
context: Read app/pytest.ini (or pyproject.toml test config). Verify: (1) integration and slow_integration markers are properly defined; (2) tests marked @pytest.mark.integration are actually integration tests (hitting real services, not just unit tests with that marker); (3) the test runner command excludes slow integration tests by default as documented in .junie/guidelines.md.
acceptance_criteria: Sample of @pytest.mark.integration tests reviewed for correctness
